summary: Tested unified 'Livraison & Coursier' section on UserHome (mobile 430px) per review request. All 4 review scenarios pass: (1) unique section data-testid='delivery-coursier-section' present with 'Livraison & Coursier' title; (2) old sections 'Services de Livraison', 'Colis & Coursier', 'Livraison Genie & Runner' and data-testid='genie-runner-section' fully removed; (3) tile navigation works: Delivery Genie -> /runner?mode=genie, Delivery Runner -> /runner, Livraison Colis -> /parcel, Livraison Repas -> /food; (4) section order is correct: Taxi -> Livraison & Coursier -> Acheter Vendre & Louer -> SB Travel -> ... ; 0 console errors. ONE MINOR ISSUE FOUND: the section contains 7 tiles instead of expected ~6 because 'Livraison Colis' appears TWICE (hcat_018df7c45a from displayFor('delivery') AND hcat_bf41959b97 from displayFor('parcel')) — both navigate to /parcel. This duplication is created by ...displayFor('delivery') + ...displayFor('parcel') merging without dedup when backend categorises Colis under both groups.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Livraison Colis' tile appears 2x (hcat_018df7c45a + hcat_bf41959b97), both linking to /parcel. The merge `...displayFor('delivery') + ...displayFor('parcel')` does not deduplicate categories that exist in both groups.

action_items: Deduplicate tiles in the unified delivery section: when merging displayFor('delivery') with displayFor('parcel'), filter by tile id/name so 'Livraison Colis' appears only once (suggest using a Map keyed on s.id or s.name and skip duplicates, or exclude 'parcel'-category items from the 'delivery' list before merging).
critical_code_review_comments: UserHome.js L436-441: the merge `[...displayFor('delivery').filter(...), ...displayFor('parcel').filter(...), genie, runner]` works but causes visible duplicate 'Livraison Colis' tiles because backend categorisation places the parcel tile under both groups. Add a dedup step (e.g. Object.values(Map(...)) keyed on tile.id) before .map.

Aside from the dup, the unified section spec is correctly implemented: 'Livraison & Coursier' title via SectionHeader, grid-cols-4, Genie path '/runner?mode=genie' and Runner path '/runner' both wired through the ServiceTile -> go(s.path) flow, ORDERED_SECTIONS no longer contains 'parcel' or 'genie', and the legacy data-testid 'genie-runner-section' is gone from the codebase (grep returned 0 matches).

rca of the issue: The unified section is built by spreading two arrays: `[...displayFor('delivery').filter(no-more), ...displayFor('parcel').filter(no-more), genie, runner]`. The backend (home_categories) currently returns the 'Livraison Colis' category under BOTH the 'delivery' group and the 'parcel' group (hcat_018df7c45a vs hcat_bf41959b97 — different ids but same name+path '/parcel'). Naive concatenation therefore produces two identical-looking tiles. Mitigation: dedup by tile path OR by name before mapping, e.g. `const seen = new Set(); tiles.filter(t => { const k = t.path||t.name; if(seen.has(k))return false; seen.add(k); return true; })`.
